# Issue labels

DoozCTL uses a small, stable set of issue labels. Anyone can propose a new
label in a PR that updates this file.

| Label | Color | Meaning |
|-------|-------|---------|
| `bug` | d73a4a | A defect: something behaves contrary to the spec or help text. |
| `enhancement` | a2eeef | A requested improvement or new capability. |
| `documentation` | 0075ca | Docs, site, or examples work. |
| `good first issue` | 7057ff | Small, well-scoped task for a first-time contributor. |
| `release` | b60205 | Work required before the next tagged release. |
| `question` | d4c5f9 | Needs clarification rather than a code change. |

## Conventions

- `bug` reports must reproduce on the latest version and include the command
  and output.
- `enhancement` requests must explain the real workflow problem they solve;
  DoozCTL is minimal by design and will decline scope creep.
- `release` issues belong in the [release checklist](../RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md)
  and are closed only by a tag.
